meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 安装后，当你要求分析 Git 差异时，Claude 会加载知识图谱，找出变更文件及关联组件，然后生成包含变更组件、受影响组件、架构层和风险的结构化分析报告，并保存可视化数据。
howto.when: 当你需要分析 Git 差异或 Pull Request 以了解变更内容、受影响组件和风险时触发，例如在功能分支上对比主分支，或有未提交更改时。

say.text: 分析当前分支的Git差异，告诉我哪些组件受影响。
say.note: Claude会读取知识图谱并列出变更和受影响的组件。

say.text: 评估这个Pull Request的风险，列出可能影响的架构层。
say.note: 基于复杂度和跨层依赖给出风险评级。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask to analyze a git diff, Claude loads the knowledge graph, identifies changed files and related components, then generates a structured report covering changed components, affected components, layers, and risks, and saves a diff-overlay.json for visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand changes, affected components, and risks, e.g., comparing a feature branch to main, or when there are uncommitted changes.

say_en.text: Analyze the current branch's git diff and tell me which components are affected.
say_en.note: Claude reads the knowledge graph and lists changed and affected components.

say_en.text: Assess this pull request's risk and list the affected architectural layers.
say_en.note: Risk rating from complexity and cross-layer dependencies.
